entries.label: RRSP lifetime excess-contribution buffer
entries.notes: One-time lifetime cushion. Beyond it: 1%/month on highest excess. Excess tax return T1-OVP due within 90 days of year-end.

entries.label: RRSP withdrawal withholding tax (outside Quebec)
entries.notes: Quebec totals = federal withholding + 14% QC: $5,000 -> 19%, $5,001-15,000 -> 24%, above $15,000 -> 29%. Withholding is a prepayment, not the final tax.

entries.label: RRSP maturity at age 71
entries.notes: Final contributions by Dec 31 of the year you turn 71 (the March 1 deadline does not apply). Convert to RRIF or annuity; minimum RRIF withdrawals begin after conversion.
